description.en: An electromagnetic wave propagating along the x-axis. The electric field (E) oscillates along the y-axis, and the magnetic field (B) oscillates along the z-axis. They are mutually perpendicular.
description.hi: x-अक्ष के अनुदिश संचरित होने वाली एक विद्युतचुंबकीय तरंग। विद्युत क्षेत्र (E) y-अक्ष के अनुदिश दोलन करता है, और चुंबकीय क्षेत्र (B) z-अक्ष के अनुदिश दोलन करता है। ये परस्पर लंबवत होते हैं।

svgContent:
<svg viewBox="0 0 500 300" xmlns="http://www.w3.org/2000/svg">
  <!-- Axes -->
  <line x1="50" y1="150" x2="450" y2="150" stroke="#9ca3af" stroke-width="2" /> <!-- X-axis (Propagation) -->
  <line x1="50" y1="250" x2="50" y2="20" stroke="#9ca3af" stroke-width="2" /> <!-- Y-axis (E-field) -->
  <line x1="50" y1="150" x2="150" y2="250" stroke="#9ca3af" stroke-width="2" /> <!-- Z-axis (B-field) -->

  <!-- Axis Labels -->
  <text x="460" y="155" font-family="Arial" font-size="14" fill="#4b5563">X (c)</text>
  <text x="35" y="30" font-family="Arial" font-size="14" fill="#4b5563">Y (E)</text>
  <text x="155" y="260" font-family="Arial" font-size="14" fill="#4b5563">Z (B)</text>

  <!-- Electric Field (E) Wave (Red, on XY plane) -->
  <path d="M50,150 Q100,50 150,150 T250,150 T350,150 T450,150" fill="none" stroke="#ef4444" stroke-width="3" />
  <!-- E-field Vectors -->
  <line x1="100" y1="150" x2="100" y2="75" stroke="#ef4444" stroke-width="1.5" />
  <polygon points="100,75 97,80 103,80" fill="#ef4444" />
  <line x1="200" y1="150" x2="200" y2="225" stroke="#ef4444" stroke-width="1.5" />
  <polygon points="200,225 197,220 203,220" fill="#ef4444" />
  <line x1="300" y1="150" x2="300" y2="75" stroke="#ef4444" stroke-width="1.5" />
  <polygon points="300,75 297,80 303,80" fill="#ef4444" />
  <line x1="400" y1="150" x2="400" y2="225" stroke="#ef4444" stroke-width="1.5" />
  <polygon points="400,225 397,220 403,220" fill="#ef4444" />

  <!-- Magnetic Field (B) Wave (Blue, on XZ plane, drawn slanted to simulate 3D) -->
  <path d="M50,150 Q100,200 150,150 T250,150 T350,150 T450,150" fill="none" stroke="#3b82f6" stroke-width="3" />
  <!-- B-field Vectors -->
  <line x1="100" y1="150" x2="75" y2="175" stroke="#3b82f6" stroke-width="1.5" />
  <polygon points="75,175 79,168 83,172" fill="#3b82f6" />
  <line x1="200" y1="150" x2="225" y2="125" stroke="#3b82f6" stroke-width="1.5" />
  <polygon points="225,125 221,132 217,128" fill="#3b82f6" />
  <line x1="300" y1="150" x2="275" y2="175" stroke="#3b82f6" stroke-width="1.5" />
  <polygon points="275,175 279,168 283,172" fill="#3b82f6" />
  <line x1="400" y1="150" x2="425" y2="125" stroke="#3b82f6" stroke-width="1.5" />
  <polygon points="425,125 421,132 417,128" fill="#3b82f6" />

</svg>
